name: manual_bef611
claim: PR frugality: open one consolidated PR per repository per session, stack a draft on an existing open PR only when the work truly depends on it, and never open a PR per fix, per finding or per agent; before opening or keeping any PR compare its merged tree with the base, because a PR whose tree equals main adds nothing and is closed in favour of the consolidated one; consolidate only recent still-relevant commits from every agent and park stale review lanes and never-merge branches, naming them on the board.

decisions.notes: Operator ruling 2026-11-26: frugality and efficiency on top of consolidation. PR 522 duplicated records already in main through 517, so its merged tree equalled main; the corrections went into the consolidated draft instead of a new PR, and sweeping 367-commit stale lanes would have produced an unreviewable PR.
